summary: Analyze logistics data, OTIF, inventory and lead-time variation. Explore this five-day supply chain analytics course and its practical exercises.
lede: Supply chain analytics uses order, inventory and transport data to explain service and operational performance. For supply chain analysts, logistics supervisors and inventory planners, the course develops spreadsheet skills to check data quality, calculate service and forecast-error measures, and segment inventory. Participants also assess supplier lead-time variation and prioritize exceptions in concise KPI-based reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with order, inventory, supplier, warehouse or transport data and need to turn operational records into defensible decisions.
modules: OTIF and Supply Chain KPI Design
prerequisites: Working familiarity with supply chain or logistics operations and routine performance measures is expected. Basic spreadsheet use is helpful; no coding or programming is required. AI-assisted anomaly detection is introduced conceptually, not as a model-building exercise.
